name: Subscription Tracker
description: Track every SaaS subscription, monitor costs, get renewal alerts, and identify redundancies — powered by Commander Tables, Calendar, and Spreadsheets. Replaces Zylo, Torii, and Cledara.

sections.name: Dashboard
sections.purpose: Total monthly/annual spend, upcoming renewals, spend by category donut, cost trend chart, redundancy alerts
contentQuestions: What key metrics should appear at the top? (total monthly spend, annual spend, upcoming renewals count, average cost per subscription)
What charts show spend trends? (monthly cost trend line, category breakdown donut)
What alerts should surface? (renewals this week, redundant tools, cancellation deadlines)
sections.designNotes: Sky blue #0EA5E9 primary. Metric cards in a 4-column grid. Charts side by side below. Alerts panel with warning/danger colour coding. Geist font with tabular figures for amounts.

sections.name: Subscription List
sections.purpose: All subscriptions in a filterable table with status, cost, renewal date, owner, and utilisation
contentQuestions: What columns should the table show? (name, vendor, category, cost, billing cycle, next renewal, status, owner, seats used/purchased)
What filters are needed? (status, category, billing cycle, owner, cost range)
What quick actions should each row support? (edit, pause, cancel, view cost history)
sections.designNotes: Status badges: active=green, trial=blue, paused=yellow, cancelled=red, expired=grey. Cost column right-aligned with normalised monthly equivalent shown in muted text. Seat utilisation as a mini progress bar.

sections.name: Add Subscription
sections.purpose: Form to add/edit a subscription with cost, billing cycle, category, owner, seat counts
contentQuestions: What fields are required? (name, cost, billing cycle, next renewal date, start date, status)
What fields are optional? (vendor, category, owner, seats, login URL, notes, tags, cancellation notice days)
Should the form support auto-renew toggle and end date for fixed-term subscriptions?
sections.designNotes: Modal form with clear sections: Basics, Cost & Billing, Ownership & Seats, Details. Currency selector next to amount. Billing cycle as radio buttons. Category dropdown with colour dots.

sections.name: Renewals Calendar
sections.purpose: Calendar view of upcoming renewals synced to Commander Calendar with alerts
contentQuestions: What calendar views are needed? (month view with renewal dots, week view with detail cards)
What should each renewal event show? (subscription name, cost, auto-renew status, cancellation deadline)
How should alerts work? (email reminders at 30, 7, and 1 day before renewal)
sections.designNotes: Month view with coloured dots on renewal dates. Click a date to see renewal details in a side panel. Upcoming renewals panel on the right. Warning badges for cancellation deadlines.

sections.name: Cost Analysis
sections.purpose: Spend breakdown by category, monthly trend chart, annual projection, budget vs actual via Spreadsheets
contentQuestions: What charts are needed? (spend by category donut, monthly trend line, annual projection bar)
How should budget vs actual work? (per-category budget limits with progress bars)
What export options exist? (Commander Spreadsheet with monthly summary, CSV export)
sections.designNotes: Use recharts for all charts. Category colours from st_categories.colour. Budget progress bars: green under 80%, yellow 80-100%, red over 100%. Annual projection as a stacked bar showing committed vs projected spend.

design.colorPalette: Clean — sky blue (#0EA5E9) primary, white background, green for active/healthy, amber for renewing soon, red for expired/cancelled
design.typography: Geist sans-serif, tabular figures for amounts

what_you_build: A subscription tracking app with renewal alerts, cost analysis, redundancy detection, and budget monitoring. Replaces Zylo, Torii, and Cledara.
